statements.quote: Our AI Cloud Services revenue for the years ended June 30, 2026 and 2025 was $128.8 million and $16.4 million, respectively, an increase of $112.4 million.
statements.notes: Fiscal 2026 figure recorded; the fiscal 2025 comparative ($16.4 million) is a prior year and not recorded.

statements.quote: Cost of revenue - AI Cloud Services for the years ended June 30, 2026 and 2025 was $16.9 million and $1.3 million, respectively, an increase of $15.6 million.
statements.notes: This is cost of revenue for the AI Cloud Services segment (electricity, employee benefits, other direct expenses), excluding depreciation. It is an AI operating cost, not total company opex.

statements.quote: The payments for computer hardware of $1,335.1 million primarily relates to AI hardware.
statements.notes: Total cash payments for computer hardware, stated to be 'primarily' AI hardware. The AI part is not separately quantified, so scope is total. No year in the sentence; this is the fiscal 2026 cash flow.

statements.quote: The payment for property, plant and equipment net of computer hardware of $2,998.0 million primarily relates to the continuing expansion of our data center capacity at Childress, including Horizons 1-4, and at the Sweetwater 1 and Sweetwater 2 sites as well as the transition of the British Columbia data centers to AI Cloud.
statements.notes: PP&E payments excluding computer hardware, driven by data center expansion and the AI Cloud transition. The AI part is not separately stated. No year in the sentence; this is the fiscal 2026 cash flow.

statements.quote: We anticipate making significant investments for the foreseeable future, including capital requirements associated with our agreement with Microsoft announced in November 2025 (the “Microsoft Agreement”), as well as GPU acquisitions and the development of additional data center capacity.
statements.notes: Forward-looking capex for GPUs and AI data center capacity; no amount given.

statements.quote: These commitments include committed capital expenditure on AI hardware and infrastructure related to site development.
statements.notes: Refers to $13,810.0 million of total commitments as of June 30, 2026, stated in the prior sentence. That figure is not recorded as an amount because the sentence stating it does not link it to AI, and it may include non-capex commitments.
